sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Media and Film Staff visa (subclass 423) closed to new applications on 24 November 2012. You cannot apply for this visa.

You may wish to consider whether one of the following is appropriate for you:

- Temporary Activity visa (subclass 408) – for people who want to come to Australia to make a documentary or commercial
- Temporary Work (Short Stay Specialist) visa (subclass 400) – for people who want to come to Australia for short stays for up to three months to:

- make a documentary or commercial that will be shown outside Australia (and is not intended to be shown in Australia)

- do short-term non-ongoing work as a journalist or foreign correspondent
